display.summary: Release channels, a configurable update check interval, and a Check button that asks Composer for a fresh report. Plus the dynamic-modal footer field fix.
highlights: Stable and beta are separate channels. Stable is the default and excludes every prerelease; beta is an explicit opt-in in Options.
Choose how often updates are checked (5 minutes to 24 hours, default 15), and Check for updates now asks Composer for a fresh result.
Dynamic-modal footer fields such as is_active are submitted with the form again, so modal saves no longer store is_active=False.
